audit.whatIsWrong: Trundle's E is called 'Pillar of Filth' in wants.foe[1] and 'Pillar' elsewhere — the ability is Pillar of Ice. Far worse, the mechanic is stated backwards: 'Land Pillar of Filth (E) to block your Hookshot engage' and 'Bait the Pillar — it's his only tool to block your Hookshot'. His Q is only ever called 'his bite (Q)' and his passive never appears.
audit.why: Riot's text: Pillar of Ice 'creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain'. Hookshot's text: 'Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.' The pillar IS a wall — it hands Camille a grapple anchor in the middle of open lane. It can body-block a path, but writing it as the counter to her engage inverts the single most important interaction in the matchup, and the mirror already ships the correct version from Trundle's side: 'never drop it in open lane where she can grapple off it' and 'Grapple the Pillar you just gave her'. His Q is Chomp — an auto-attack reset that steals AD — and his passive King's Tribute heals him off nearby dying units, which is the other half of why long trades lose.
audit.corrected: Pillar of Ice named correctly and restated as terrain Camille can grapple; Chomp and King's Tribute named; the 'bait the pillar' instruction replaced with the real one — bait him into placing it, then use it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags this matchup for having no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and it is right — not one duration appears.
audit.why: The numbers are what make this lane legible. Chomp is 3.5s flat, so his AD steal is permanent pressure rather than a window. Frozen Domain is 18s at rank 1, which is the actual gap you trade into. Pillar of Ice is 21s at rank 1 — his longest basic cooldown and, since it is a wall for you, the one you want him to spend. Hookshot is 16s.
audit.corrected: Chomp 3.5s, Frozen Domain 18s and Pillar of Ice 21s written into early, mid and the spikes.

notes: 'Pillar of Filth' was a fabricated ability name, and the mechanic behind it was stated backwards in two places — Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain, and Camille's Hookshot requires terrain, so his E is a grapple anchor she can use, not a counter to her engage. The mirror at audits/top/trundle__camille.json already tells Trundle players not to drop it in open lane against her; both pages now agree. The packet's 'no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' defect is cleared with Chomp 3.5s, Frozen Domain 18s and Pillar of Ice 21s. Packet also flagged 'Hextech Ultimatum' — a near-miss of the real name, corrected.
